title: Wannabe Gangster Cries For His Mom After Getting In Trouble
description:
#news #police #arrest

On January 21st, 2023. An officer was dispatched to a public disturbance at a club. Upon arrival, the officer immediately noticed multiple individuals yelling and being rowdy. Witnesses were saying a male named Trent was the main cause of the disturbance and she stated that "He kept grabbing his backpack". The officer tried approaching Trent and he was less than cooperative with everyone that was trying to help him. He kept saying "Stop touching me" as people were trying to lead him to safety. He eventually tried to fight someone aswell. When officers tried to detain him, that's when the real chaos ensues. He kept saying he wanted his mom the whole time.
